title: Example workflows
description: Ready-made multi-agent workflows for typical tasks at work and at home. The preview costs nothing; “Copy to my workflows” creates your own workflow that you can edit freely.
galleryText: Ready-made multi-agent workflows with a test task to try out and adapt. The templates themselves never change.
noMatch: No example matches the search and category.

preview.syntheticNote: The test task contains invented sample data. After copying it is in the start node; replace it there with your own data.
preview.sensitiveNote: This example belongs to {{field}}. The agents produce working aids, not advice: check every result professionally before you use it.
preview.costNote: Previewing and copying are free and call no model. Costs only arise when you run the copy; all it needs is access to the providers of its models.
preview.samplesNote: Small invented files for trying out the file fields. Download them here; a copy also offers them in its run dialog.
preview.copyTests: Add the test cases as a test series
preview.copyTestsNote: Creates a test series with these cases. Nothing is run, no schedule is created and no API is published.
preview.orchestratorNote: Does not work on the task itself: it decides at run time which teams work on it and combines their results.
preview.teamsNote: The orchestrator picks the teams that fit the task while it runs. When you copy the example, every team becomes a workflow of its own that you can edit.
preview.teamParameters: Settings the orchestrator can fill in: {{names}}
preview.knowledgeNote: Created in your knowledge base when you copy. The documents are invented; the agents search them and name their sources.
preview.copyTestsConnected: Not possible with a connection: test series run without a person, and MCP tools are not allowed there. Choose offline mode to take over the test cases.
preview.memorySpaceHint: Its agents with persistent memory keep their notes in this space, apart from other copies. Leave it empty to share the example's memory space with every other copy.
preview.memorySpaceInvalid: Use up to 64 letters A–Z (without accents), digits, spaces, _ . or -, starting with a letter or digit.
preview.memorySpaceShared: Empty: shared with the other copies

connect.intro: The example works without a connection: the copy then runs in a clearly labeled offline mode with the sample data. With a connection, agents read data through approved read-only tools of an MCP server.
connect.checked: When you copy, Nodestro checks that this server offers every tool approved as read-only. If not, nothing is copied.
connect.noServers: No MCP server is set up yet, so the copy runs in offline mode.

searchPlaceholderFeatures: Name, field, building block or level …

needs.title: What you need
needs.modelsAdapted: AI provider: {{provider}}. The copy uses your default models instead of the example’s: {{models}}.
needs.approval: A run pauses for your approval before it continues.
needs.knowledge_one: Creates {{count}} knowledge file in your knowledge base.
needs.knowledge_other: Creates {{count}} knowledge files in your knowledge base.
needs.samples_one: {{count}} sample file to try the file fields (see below).
needs.samples_other: {{count}} sample files to try the file fields (see below).
needs.files: Takes your own files as input.
needs.connection: Optional connection (MCP): {{names}}. Without it, the copy runs offline with sample data.
needs.noConnection: No connection to other services needed.

models.title: Models on this computer
models.text: This workspace uses local models. Each agent gets the model its task needs on this computer; you can choose another one per agent. Your choice is kept in the copy.

reason.needs_download: Needs a download before the first run.
reason.installed_alternative: The best model for this task needs a download; an installed one is used.
reason.default_model: No installed model suits this task: the workspace default model stays.

origin.offlineTip_one: A copy of the example “{{example}}”: {{names}} runs offline on sample data, without a connection. For real data, copy the example again and choose an MCP server.
origin.offlineTip_other: A copy of the example “{{example}}”: {{names}} run offline on sample data, without a connection. For real data, copy the example again and choose an MCP server.

services.title: Services for the tools
services.intro: The agents of this example search the web. Choose one of your search service connections for it. Nothing is preselected: you decide which provider receives your searches.
services.none: You have no “{{type}}” connection yet. Set one up now or later under Tools → Connections.
services.later: Without a choice the copy is still created; the check before a run reminds you to choose a connection in the agent.

kinds.label: Kind
kinds.partsIntro: Building blocks are small workflows that examples use as a team or sub-workflow. Taken over as a workflow of your own, they are offered as a team in the editor's palette.
kinds.partCopyNote: The copy is a workflow of your own that you can change freely; the building block itself stays unchanged. Building blocks it uses are taken over too.
kinds.skillsIntro: Skills are instructions in the open Agent Skills format. An agent loads a skill when its task needs it. Scripts inside skills are never run.
kinds.skillCopyNote: Version {{version}}. Taking it over creates a skill of your own that you can assign to agents and change; a newer Nodestro version never changes it.
